intent: TEST for TelemetryWindowClosedEvent at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/shared/events/TelemetryWindowClosedEvent.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing publishes, Telemetry Stream Broadcasting consumes: shared kernel event record in package com.pulsestream.telemetry.shared.events (no domain types of any context). Record TelemetryWindowClosedEvent(String deviceId, Instant windowStart, Instant windowEnd, List<TelemetrySampleEvent> samples). Rejects blank deviceId, null instants, windowEnd not after windowStart; samples is defensively copied into an unmodifiable list ordered as supplied (ascending tDevice) and may not be null.
